I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the next renewal at Brackenwater Freight Co. is 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 October. Nothing later in the channel changes it. Marcus is in that channel, so he could already see her post. I told him I couldn't check the date against anything else, because there are no Brackenwater files in the share. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.
